subject: Air freight quote request: DUS to KUL
body:
Dear Air Freight Team,

Could you please quote your cheapest air freight option from DUS to KUL (Kuala Lumpur, MY)? We will deliver the shipment to DUS ourselves. It will be ready on 2026-11-26.

The shipment consists of 12 pieces of spare parts for packaging machines, with a gross weight of 1549 kg and a total volume of 8.26 cbm.

Please provide an all-in price in EUR.

Thank you for your assistance.

Mit freundlichen Gruessen / Kind regards
Jonas Kessler
Logistics Coordinator
Kessler Feinmechanik GmbH, Ulm
